data.key: Monk of the Sacred Mountain ~ Adamantine Monk
data.name: Adamantine Monk
data.description: At 9th level, a monk of the sacred mountain has muscles so strong and skin so resilient that he gains DR 1/-. This DR increases by 1 for every three levels thereafter. As a swift action, the monk can spend 1 ki point to double his DR until the beginning of his next turn. This ability replaces improved evasion.
